title: AI Ethics
intro: These stories connect Texas data-center growth and AI accountability with community access and human connection. Texas reporting asks who oversees permits and environmental effects as data centers expand.

items.title: Texas data-center governance, permits, and air quality
items.description: Three Texas updates surface the stakes of data-center growth: Rick Perry lost a board reelection vote at Fermi; watchdog concerns led officials to disable an online permit filing system; and a Houston Advanced Research Center analysis warns that growth could reverse air-quality gains, especially with on-site natural-gas power.

items.title: We are telling AI chatbots our biggest secrets, but Proton warns our privacy is at huge risk
items.description: Proton's survey found 66% of UK AI users had discussed at least one sensitive topic with a chatbot, while 42% had little or no trust in AI companies to protect their data—a gap between disclosure and confidence.

items.title: Meta's AI shopping agent threatens Amazon's lucrative advertising business
items.description: Meta's AI shopping assistant Muse could threaten Amazon's retail and advertising dominance, showing how AI agents may shift power across digital commerce platforms.

items.title: Proton's CTO wrote a manifesto for the AI coding age. It struck a nerve with engineers.
items.description: Proton's CTO argues that AI has fundamentally changed software engineering, prompting engineers to debate how coding work and roles will evolve.

items.title: Spurs² Hackathon at UT Austin
items.description: Raj participated in the hackathon; his recap shares the project notes and work.

items.title: IRL.group: a home for local creators
items.description: IRL.group gives city and community creators a place to bring people together offline.

items.title: Why Every Election Matters to Democracy with Stacey Abrams
items.description: Guy Kawasaki and Stacey Abrams discuss voting rights, democracy, and persistence. It connects to a core technology value: digital tools should make voting easier to access, not create new barriers. With Election Day approaching, remember to vote.
